</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: 2em;"><b>Third Stratagem</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><b>借刀杀人</b></span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">(jiè
dāo shā rén)</span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="font-weight: normal; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: x-large;"><i>Kill
with a Borrowed Knife</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">Attack
an opponent using the strength of another, especially in a situation
where using one's own strength is not favorable. For example, one
might deceive an ally into attacking, or bribe an official into
turning traitor.</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: medium;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">General
Guan Yu (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">关羽</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">,
died 220 A.D.) of the State of Shu fought in the Battle of Fancheng
(219 A.D.) which the warlord Liu Bei (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">刘备</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">,
161-223 A.D.) waged against General Cao Cao (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">曹操</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">,
155-220 A.D.) of the State of Wei. Cao Cao sent word to General Sun
Quan (</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">孙权</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">,
182-252 A.D.) of the State of Wu encouraging him to attack Jing
Province, promising him all of the lands south of the Yangze River
upon victory. Weeks later, the State of Wu, having allied itself in
secret with the State of Wei, attacked Guan </span>
</p>
<p class="western" style="break-before: page; line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; page-break-before: always; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">Yu's
army at Jiangling. Having previously been an ally to Shu, Sun Quan
was there able to surprise and overwhelm the Shu forces. Guan Yu was
forced to retreat. During the retreat he was captured by Sun Quan's
troops and executed. These events caused immense hatred between Liu
Bei and Sun Quan, and led to many battles between the two states.
Although Cao Cao did not live to see it, Wei eventually defeated both
Shu and Wu, and unified China [3].</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i>Kill
With a Borrowed Knife</i> is associated with the 41st hexagram,
<i>Mountain over Thunder</i>. The relationship is apparent when one
observes that the yang line which, before, was in the third position
from the bottom, has moved upward, and is now in the top position.
What was below has moved upward, thereby weakening the foundation --
a weakening from which, when suffered by an opponent, one may benefit
 [1], [28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">


	
	
	
	

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>Sample Sentences 3:</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section58" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我明天应该穿什么衣服上学？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: What should I wear to
	school tomorrow?</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我应该穿这条裤子和这件衬衫？还是</span></span>
    <span style="padding-left: 30px;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;这条连衣裙？</span>
    </span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">但是你前天穿过那一条裤子。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	3) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我在哪里可以买一条裙子？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">这条路</span></span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">上</span></span><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">有一个小店有裙子卖。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	4) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">怎么走？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">一直走到那棵树，然后左拐。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">没有电梯，只有楼梯。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: There is no
	escalator, only stairs.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	6) Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我的</span></span>T-<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">恤在哪？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	 <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">在那个箱子里。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你的袜子在这个袋子里。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你明天工作吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">10</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"> </span><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">谁借了你的小刀？</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">11</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"> </span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times; color: #0047AB !important;">她会杀牛。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这座楼怎么进去？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">请进。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们稍后要买衣服。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">还有两天才到星期五。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">自上月以来我看了两本书。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	14) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">水太冰了的话那我不要喝。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	15) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">如果买一辆汽车，我就买便宜的。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US">19</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US">)</span></span><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">怎么从这座楼里出来？</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
-------------------------------------</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/03/notes-from-china-chapter-2-besiege-wei.html">Previous Chapter</a> <br /></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/03/notes-from-china-chapter-4-wait-at.html">Next Chapter<br /></a></p>
